name: London 2100 — orbital corridor
notes: OS Open Zoomstack contours relaxed to a 100 m DEM, plus AONB, Green Belt, built-up, woodland, water, road and rail. The 17 control points are the study's nominal station sites; Greater London is a no-go zone. Carries the settled 412 km orbital from the v12 delivery build as a reference alignment.

reference.name: Settled orbital — London 2100 v12
reference.notes: 412 km, seventeen stations, worked in both directions. The line the study settled on — geometry and journey times unchanged since v11; v12 was a presentation build.
